findings.claim: Unlike the file's other describe (line 226-231, which skips every project but desktop-chromium), the new describe has no project restriction and derives its shell expectation from `testInfo.project.name === "desktop-chromium"`, so a full-suite run also executes it on WebKit `mobile-safari` and on `desktop-compact` (whose native 1366x768 desktop viewport is then overridden to 390x680 and asserted as `mobile-chat-shell`) — neither covered by the recorded two-project evidence.
findings.reproduction: npx playwright test tests/e2e/prompt-refiner-chat-input.spec.ts --grep 'same-instance fixture mode transitions' --list  → lists 8 entries across desktop-chromium, desktop-compact, mobile-safari, mobile-chromium, while package-round1.json testResults records only --project=desktop-chromium --project=mobile-chromium; add a project guard (or drive the shell from viewport) if only Chromium is intended.

findings.claim: The Chat probe only counts POSTs and never reads `route.request().postData()`, so the requirement's "합성 제안문이 … Chat POST로 승격되지 않아야 한다" is evidenced only by a count; the one POST the positive control does observe is never checked to carry the authored text rather than the synthetic proposal.
findings.reproduction: In the `/\/api\/chat(?:$|\?)/` handler capture `route.request().postData()` into an array before `route.abort("aborted")`, then after the positive-control click assert the captured body contains SOURCE_PROMPT and `not.toContain(synthetic)`; re-run `npx playwright test tests/e2e/prompt-refiner-chat-input.spec.ts --project=desktop-chromium --project=mobile-chromium --grep 'same-instance fixture mode transitions' --workers=1 --retries=0`.

findings.claim: The fixture-only client component is statically imported by the production chat shell, so its code is emitted into the client bundle of every chat route even though the loopback+cookie gate means it can never render there.
findings.reproduction: npm run build; then grep -r "prompt-refiner-fixture-refresh" .next/static/chunks — the testid appears in a shipped chunk; a `next/dynamic` import (or a test-only module boundary) keeps it out.

verdict.nextAction: Land as is: all four round-0 findings are addressed (real desktop 1366x768 `desktop-chat-shell` + mobile 390x680 runs recorded with command and output, an off-mode positive control that observes exactly one aborted Chat POST, and a single shared `promptRefinerMode` const feeding both the probe attribute and ChatPageClient), with the three findings above recorded as non-blocking follow-ups.
